caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: The Attribute Dictionary defines schema attributes and includes references to the events and objects in which they are used.
name: dictionary

arcticwolf_metadata.caption: Arctic Wolf Metadata
arcticwolf_metadata.description: The Arctic Wolf metadata object describes Arctic Wolf platform-specific attributes associated with the event.

attack_surface_uids.caption: Attack Surface IDs
attack_surface_uids.description: The list of normalized identifiers of the attack surfaces associated with the event. See specific usage.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The attack surface is not mapped. See the attack_surfaces attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

attack_surfaces.caption: Attack Surfaces
attack_surfaces.description: The list of attack surfaces associated with the event, normalized to the captions of the attack_surface_uids values. In the case of 'Other', they are defined by the event source.

customer.caption: Customer
customer.description: The Arctic Wolf customer associated with the event.

ingestion_service.caption: Service
ingestion_service.description: The Arctic Wolf service that produced the event.

deployment.caption: Deployment
deployment.description: The Arctic Wolf deployment associated with the event.

endpoint.caption: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The service endpoint associated with the event. See specific usage.

id.caption: ID
id.description: The unique identifier. See specific usage.

timestamp.caption: Event Timestamp
timestamp.description: The event timestamp determined by Arctic Wolf using a datetime as defined in RFC 3339
